description:
Recording of a waterfall on the Rorota Trail in Rémire-Montjoly, French Guiana.
The waterfall is about 7 metres from the microphones, with frogs and insects in the surrounding forest.

Recorder MixPre6 II
ORTF Setup: 2 x CCM4 Schoeps Microphones in a Cinela windscreen
Original Recording in Wave, 96kHz, 24bit
GPS 4.876720, -52.262344
REF: GUY-260122-08
Date: 22 January 2026

Recorded during a residency at Guyane Art Factory, Cayenne, French Guiana, in January 2026.
name: Waterfall, Frogs and Insects - Rorota Trail, French Guiana
